name: entity-card
title: Entity Card
description: A selectable list card for turtles, sites or scripts: status dot, title, right-side tag, a meta line and an optional fuel bar. The selected card gets an orange border and block shadow.
usage: select("testy")}> Testy Online Strip mine 41/64 120 12 -352 Fuel 72%
notes: The card is a button with aria-pressed when selected is set. With asChild it renders your link and marks the selected one with aria-current. Do not put other buttons inside it.
EntityCardMeta pushes its last child to the right. EntityCardBar is green and turns red at or below lowAt (20).
